label: Pro Sports Teams & Performance
heroHeading: Empower your athletes with elite-level recovery solutions
seoDescription: Professional athlete recovery systems — HBOT, contrast therapy & red light. Data-driven protocols for team performance centers.

valueProps.title: Peak performance
valueProps.body: Join the elite teams using cutting-edge recovery technology to get more out of their most valuable athletes, accelerating recovery and reducing injury downtime.

valueProps.title: Integrated systems
valueProps.body: Our products integrate into existing training facilities, backed by a team that helps your staff build protocols and workflows that drive consistent athlete use.

valueProps.title: Built for intensity
valueProps.body: Engineered for high-frequency, heavy-duty use. Our products withstand the demands of professional sports environments.

valueProps.title: Dedicated team support
valueProps.body: A dedicated technical support team keeps your facility operating without interruption.

features.title: Give your athletes the competitive edge
features.body: Professional sports teams demand the best recovery tools. OneBase provides hyperbaric oxygen therapy, contrast therapy and red light therapy designed for high-performance environments. Help your athletes recover faster, train harder and perform at their peak.

features.title: Data-driven recovery protocols
features.body: Coming late 2026, OneBase's monitoring platform tracks usage patterns and session metrics across your entire team, so you can make informed decisions about recovery protocols with real-time insights.
